__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Your typical smelly, blind flying mammal.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bat flaps wildly at you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bat

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He has lost his family and everything of his former life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A templar page in training is here looking mildly confused.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle page templar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He recently discovered these catacombs and wants to see where they lead.
He just hopes he doesn't get killed in the process.  He carries only
essential exploration gear; if there IS anything down here, he
probably won't last long.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A spelunker knows his way around these tunnels.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spelunker explorer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Working for an evil necromancer isn't the greatest thing in the world.
They seem like little more than zombie servants themselves.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gravedigger digger robber graverobber

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: In fact it IS alive in a magical sort of sense.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Some mist swirls about you here ... it seems ALIVE!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mist swirling

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Even though he has died in the physical sense of the word, the battle
continues for him in his charmed state.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A skeletal soldier fights in the battle of the underworld.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle skeleton skeletal soldier

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you peer closely he peers back at you

A templar peers closely at you.
A templar tells you, "You are an evil force trying to spread your ways!".
A templar tells you, "You must die for your sin!".
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A templar shouts "AKK! SLAY THE INFIDEL!"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle templar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Hard to tell much about the mysterious form even upon further inspection.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mysterious ghostly wraith forms before your eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wraith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A templar officer tells you "Better move along evil one!"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A templar officer keeps an eye on things here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle officer templar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He seems to lack real interest in what he is doing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A blank-faced zombie mage joins the battle.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle zombie mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bat flaps wildly at you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bat vampire

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Though he seems absorbed in his work, you'd bet he'd take the time out
to kill you to get a fresh corpse!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The evil necromancer makes undead soldiers from corpses.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle necromancer necro cleric

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A slight, tolerant smile comes briefly across his face.  In the blink
of an eye he seems stern again.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The grand templar stands here quietly observing your actions
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle grand templar leader

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The spray of colored light bouncing off his scales is almost blinding.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The light shines off a beautiful but dangerous dragon lurking here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prism dragon prismdragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see nothing more than the sense of darkness and evil.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: You hear and smell the presence of the darkenbeast.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle darken dark beast darkenbeast
